## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows the Selection Policy and CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] The resource has a distinct production UI engineering purpose.
- [ ] The URL is canonical, first-party, HTTPS, and not already listed.
- [ ] The description, Use when, and Watch for fields are concise and non-overlapping.
- [ ] Metadata follows Frameworks → Platforms → Requirements → License.
- [ ] License information is verified from the upstream project when code is distributed.
- [ ] I disclosed any personal, employer, client, or commercial relationship.
- [ ] I did not add maintenance-only audit fields, dates, candidate labels, or internal lists to user-facing entries.
- [ ] Local or automated checks pass.
